reviewerName: Codex AI-assisted editor synthesizing independent Luna and Terra route reviews

Rights/authorship remain supported only by local declarations and were not independently verified. Routes requested: gpt-6-luna (runtime-visible label GPT-6; configured route not exposed) and gpt-5.6-terra (Terra confirmed; runtime label Codex GPT-6). This v2 review is historical and was not used to approve; its non-blocking scope note led to the v3 gloss revision and a full new review.
